title: View Model Customizer (Animations)
description: A minimalist Open Source Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.4+ that gives you complete control over your first-person viewmodel.
body:
View Model Customizer

Fine-tune the way your held items look in first person.
Move, rotate and scale the viewmodel, save profiles, and control swing/equip animations — all client-side.

> 🖥️ **Client-side only.** Install it for yourself; the server does not need the mod. ## ✨ What you can tweak | Control | What it does | | :-- | :-- | | 📏 **Size** | Changes the held-item scale. | | ↔️ **Position X / Y / Z** | Moves the item with a range from `-100` to `100`. | | 🔄 **Yaw / Pitch / Roll** | Rotates the item around its own axis — no flying across the screen. | | ↩️ **Reset controls** | Reset one setting or restore the active profile's defaults. | | 📁 **Profiles** | Create, rename, delete and instantly switch setups. Everything saves automatically. | | ⚔️ **No Swing** | Removes swing side movement while keeping item rotation. | | 📐 **Scale Swing** | Makes the swing animation respect your item scale. | | 🚫 **No Equip** | Disables the draw/equip animation when switching items. | ## 🚀 Installation 1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) and Fabric API for your Minecraft version. 2. Download the matching jar: - `View Model Customizer-mc1.21.11-3.3.jar` for Minecraft **1.21.11**; - `View Model Customizer-mc26.1.2-3.3.jar` for Minecraft **26.1.2**. ## 🎮 Usage Press `V` to open the editor. The keybind can be changed in Minecraft's controls. Create a profile for each setup, tune its position/rotation, and the changes are saved automatically. Empty hands keep their normal vanilla animation instead of inheriting an item offset. ## 📄 License [MIT](LICENSE)
